studies.title: Robot arm inverse dynamics
studies.description: Three motor-driven axes follow prescribed angles; MBDyn returns the torque, power and energy each motor must deliver.
studies.next: Run it, then plot Rotary drive torque and choose shoulder, elbow or base_yaw.

studies.title: Double-wishbone quarter-car
studies.description: SLA suspension on a wheel-pad rig swept through ±60 mm of travel. Watch camber gain and bump steer from the arm and tie-rod geometry.
studies.next: Run it from Solve, then open Measure → Wheel kinematics to plot camber and toe against wheel travel.

studies.title: Oleo-pneumatic gear drop test
studies.description: A 290 kg carriage drops at 2 m/s onto an oleo-pneumatic strut and damped tyre. Compare gas, orifice and tyre forces through the stroke.
studies.next: Run it, then compare oleo force components with the tyre contact force in Post-processing.

studies.title: Slider-crank engine run-up
studies.description: A flywheel, connecting rod and piston closed by spherical, universal and prismatic joints, driven by constant torque against a pumping load.
studies.next: Run it, then plot crank speed, piston travel and the joint reaction forces.

studies.title: Gyroscopic top
studies.description: A heavy top spinning at 120 rad/s on a spherical tip. Gravity torque drives slow precession with nutation loops traced by the axis.
studies.next: Run it and enable motion trails in Post-processing to see the nutation cusps.

studies.title: Tumbling T-handle
studies.description: A free T-handle in zero gravity spun about its intermediate principal axis flips every few seconds: the Dzhanibekov effect.
studies.next: Run it and plot angular velocity in body axes: the spin component reverses with each flip.

studies.title: Chaotic double pendulums
studies.description: Two identical double pendulums released 0.001° apart stay together for seconds, then diverge completely: sensitive dependence on initial conditions.
studies.next: Run it with motion trails on and watch the two bobs separate after about three seconds.

studies.title: Aircraft nose-gear kinematics
studies.description: Open-source STEP nose-gear assembly with six modelled bodies and a prescribed strut stroke. Inferred linkage; kinematic illustration only.

studies.title: Oleo strut on a wheel-end fixture
studies.description: Gas spring, asymmetric orifice damping and stroke stops on original STEP knuckle, hub and tyre parts under imposed motion.
